data.body: **[P1] Preserve fatal failures across the async invocation boundary.** These branches rethrow `VirtualMachineError` and `ThreadDeath`, but factory/start-hook execution occurs inside `DurableExecutor`'s `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync`. The future captures them, and the normal failure branch converts them into `DurableExecutionOutput.failure`; an injected `ThreadDeath` is therefore suppressed and its worker can continue after termination. After unwrapping the handler failure, finalize any published plugins and rethrow fatal causes instead of building a failure output. Add end-to-end tests through `DurableExecutor`, since direct `PluginRunner` tests miss this boundary.
